# ICT WEEK Uzbekistan 2026

> Central Asia's Premier Technology Summit and Exhibition in Tashkent, Uzbekistan.

## Overview
ICT WEEK Uzbekistan 2026 is the largest annual information and communications technology event in Central Asia, organized by IT Park Uzbekistan and the Ministry of Digital Technologies.

## Quick Links
- [Homepage](https://ictweek.uz/): Main event portal and overview
- [Registration](https://ictweek.uz/#register): Free attendee and delegation registration
- [Summit Tracks](https://ictweek.uz/#summit-tracks): Enterprise, Startup, IT Outsourcing, Global Bridge, GameGap, and AI Native summits
- [Partners & Attendees](https://ictweek.uz/#partners): Global partners including AWS, StartupBlink, DIFC, and Pegasus Tech Ventures
